notes: Plan-only evals grade strict direct review. Each operation resolves once into a retained ResolvedProject; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: plan-review-direct-command-and-capability
evals.prompt: At from-issue Phase 5, plan-review is ready, capabilities.review.plan is available, and bindings.commands[review_id].argv is ["codex-companion","task","--fresh","--reviewer","plan-review"]. Plan-only: explain selection, binding shape, direct invocation, validation, failure handling, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. Select bindings.workflow.review.plan, capabilities.review.plan, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported takes the documented native route. For available, classify the authored argv: basename codex-companion, subcommand task, --reviewer plan-review matching the running operation, optional --fresh and no other token make it the one supported shape. Any other argv, bare ["codex"] included, is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op> and its cause, and stops with no Codex call, no retry and no native fallback. Preserve base argv/cwd/env and append `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json`, sending the complete packet on stdin with no positional argument, in the foreground. Require exit 0 and exactly one JSON object with status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh, and a non-empty rawOutput, the last captured agent message, before Blocking / Should fix / Discussion establish Codex. A daemon, slot, or capacity rejection stops verbatim with no retry and no native fallback. A completed non-capacity runtime, payload, output, or schema failure takes exactly one native fallback with the same packet. The parent verifies and dispositions findings without storing the raw transcript.

evals.name: diff-review-light-packet-boundaries
evals.prompt: sdd dispatches diff-review over abc1234..def5678. Plan-only: state the packet, output, route, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.code, capabilities.review.code, and bindings.commands[review_id]. Refusal is fatal; blocked stops; unsupported takes the documented native route. IN: operation/directory/branch/base/head; correctness-only scope (bugs, boundary handling, dead branches, contract assertions, DRY, integration) explicitly excluding conformance; rubric path with values; manifest root plus all four metrics and plan routing path; verification context and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain; matching standards. OUT deliberately: issue investigation, spec, domain/context docs, planReview focus, and plan-review contract. Check the authored argv is codex-companion task --reviewer diff-review with optional --fresh; any other argv, bare ["codex"] included, is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op> and stops with no Codex call, retry or native fallback. Invoke base argv/cwd/env plus `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json`, send the packet on stdin with no positional argument, and require one JSON object with status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh and a non-empty rawOutput, then Critical / Important / Minor. Output begins Correctness Clean|Findings, has exactly those three sections, <=400 words, stable IDs, live path:line evidence, confidence, unknowns, and None. when empty. Return result unmodified with reviewer identity and scope. Capacity rejection stops verbatim, no retry/native fallback; one completed non-capacity failure gets one same-packet native fallback.

evals.name: diff-review-oversized-range-scoped-packet
evals.prompt: diff-review sees 44 product files. Plan-only: explain scope, direct review validation, and error routes.
evals.expected_output: After selecting bindings.workflow.review.code from one retained ResolvedProject, run the existing size pre-flight with resolved artifact paths. A 44-file range scopes to the first 20 helper entries without filtering/re-ranking. It preserves manifest root/all four metrics but says do not read shards, and adds item 7 with selected root-relative paths and changed-line counts. For each path run exactly one `git diff <base>..<head> -- ':(literal)<path>'`: a single literal argument after --, never shell-joined, pathspec magic disabled; no per-file diffs are embedded. The coverage says 20 of 44, listed files are the only graded files, each finding is anchored in one, and unlisted files may only be consulted as evidence. First line is exactly `**Correctness:** Clean — scoped to 20 of 44 product files; <assessment>` or Findings equivalent; bare/scoped-parenthetical forms fail. Return validated result, reviewer identity, and `scoped: 20 of 44 product files`. Only codex-companion task --reviewer diff-review with optional --fresh is driven; any other argv is a binding shape error naming the expected form codex-companion task [--fresh] --reviewer <op>, with no Codex call, retry or native fallback. Invoke the base command plus `--model gpt-6-astra --effort xhigh --cwd <absolute-worktree> --json` with the packet on stdin and no positional argument, and validate one JSON object's status 0, empty touchedFiles, runtime.model gpt-6-astra, runtime.reasoningEffort xhigh and non-empty rawOutput, then Critical/Important/Minor. Capacity rejection stops verbatim without retry/native fallback; unavailable measurement is unmeasured; one completed non-capacity runtime/output/schema failure gets same-packet native fallback. No default/inference is allowed.
